idea-plugin.name: StringSmith - Android Strings Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
StringSmith turns strings.xml management from a chore into a smooth workflow. Extract hardcoded literals with context-aware replacement, rename keys and update every reference in one undoable action, copy resources across locales, and flag duplicate or dead entries — all without leaving the editor. Works in Android and Kotlin / Compose Multiplatform projects, in both K1 and K2 modes.

Getting started: put the caret on a hardcoded string and press Ctrl+Alt+X (or Alt+Enter → Extract to strings.xml). Pick a key — done.

Extract

  • Context-aware replacement: stringResource in Composables, getString in Activity/Fragment/View, R.string in other Kotlin, @string/ in XML layouts
  • Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform: stringResource(Res.string.key) with auto-imported generated Res (package auto-detected, overridable in settings)
  • Auto-import for Compose stringResource with sorted imports
  • Duplicate-value detection during extract — reuse an existing key instead of adding a copy
  • Multi-locale propagation across values-* folders
  • Kotlin template expressions extracted as format args ("Hello $name" → %1$s + argument)
  • Quick-fix intention on hardcoded literals (Alt+Enter)
  • Quick Extract — skips the dialog when the target is unambiguous (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X)
  • Batch Extract — extract every string in a file in one pass, with colour-coded per-row status and a one-click Fix collisions action (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B)
  • Key suggestions romanize Greek/Cyrillic and strip Latin accents (Καλημέρα → kalimera)
  • @Preview composables excluded by default (configurable)

Edit

  • Rename a string key and edit its default + per-locale values in one undoable step (Ctrl+Alt+E or Alt+Enter)
  • Renames every R.string.key, Res.string.key, and @string/key reference, scoped to the declaring module and its dependents — and reports how many were updated

Duplicate

  • Copy a resource to a new key across res/values/strings.xml and every values-* locale in one undoable step (Ctrl+Alt+D or Alt+Enter)
  • Reuses each locale's existing translation; untranslated locales are skipped, not filled with the default
  • Optionally redirects the reference under the caret to the new key

Navigate

  • Alt+Click on a <string name="…"> entry in strings.xml lists every usage of the key (R.string.key, Res.string.key, @string/key) and jumps there — or shows a picker with a code snippet and File.kt:line when there is more than one. Works in Android and Compose Multiplatform.
  • Ctrl+Click jumps to the same key in the other values-* locale files. On Android this is the IDE's native gesture; StringSmith adds it for Compose Multiplatform, where it is missing.
  • Generated Res accessors are excluded; matches on the same line collapse to one entry

Inspect

  • Hardcoded string highlight (opt-in)
  • Duplicate value in strings.xml (same text, different keys)
  • Unused string resource (no reference anywhere)
  • Format-string mismatch across locales — a locale whose %s/%d arguments don't match the default entry (crashes at runtime); covers Compose Multiplatform, which Android Lint doesn't check

Settings: key prefix and naming convention, replacement style per context, locale defaults, format-arg detection, inspection toggles, exclusion patterns, custom Composable wrapper names, and a live key preview.
